notes: Recorded 15 master's and 14 doctoral rows: Xiamen's complete tables (Chinese-medium and English-medium programmes) plus Tongji's two named majors, Marine Science and Geophysics. One row per programme per university.

Correction to the earlier pass from Xiamen's section III tables: in the Chinese-medium table every programme is master's and doctoral except Marine Engineering (master's only). In the English-medium table the master's column holds only Marine Affairs and Environmental Management; the doctoral column holds Law of the Sea, the six College of Ocean and Earth Science programmes, Marine Affairs and the four College of Environment and Ecology programmes. So the six ocean-science programmes and Law of the Sea are English-medium at doctoral level only, and Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering and Ecology are English-medium at doctoral level only.

Tongji does not publish a list of marine programmes beyond its two named majors and the four schools (School of Ocean and Earth Science, School of Environmental Science and Engineering, School of Civil Engineering, College of Electronics and Information Engineering). Its master's and doctoral major lists (2027 intake) are Excel files behind a download captcha, which was not bypassed, so other Tongji majors in those four schools are not recorded.
Ocean University of China hosts the scholarship but its 2027/2028 page names no majors and points to its 'High Level Graduate Student' Program page, which also lists none.
The list is the 2026 notice at Xiamen and the 2026 notice at Tongji. Tongji published a 2027 notice on 2026-10-25 (applications for the next round); the Xiamen 2027 guide was not read.
